notes: POPETS-dataset (P02, venue popets): deterministic synthetic dataset and split builder for 'Revocation-Complete Future Disclosure for Cached Longitudinal AI Contexts'. evaluation/venue2027/popets/generate_dataset.py implements the manifest signature generate(seed, split, n) -> Dataset plus write_dataset(outdir, seed, n) by delegating record construction, family assignment, split-by-independent-unit, content hashing and the fail-closed validators (detect_split_leakage / assert_no_leakage / assert_valid_frequencies / PHI-field rejection) entirely to the audited shared kernel evaluation.venue2027._shared.dataset_kernel (v1.0.0 pinned; kernel venue families fresh / revoked_then_dispatch / cross_purpose / transitive_gap; unit prefix rev; 60/20/20 split; split-independent buffered content hash); nothing is re-implemented locally. This module adds only the POPETS-specific revocation-and-dispatch payload clara.popets.revocation-payload-v1 (revocation instant revocation_at=100 with dispatch_at in [101,400] so every record encodes a post-revocation dispatch decision; purpose over the CASE_MATRIX vocabulary self_care/care_summary/medication_review with cross_purpose records forced onto a genuinely different requested_purpose (POPETS-CASE-05 confusion); cache_mode over none/prompt_only/summary_pointer/retry_payload with 'none' reserved for fresh dispatches (RQ3 cache-hit accounting); lineage_paths over the blueprint derivation paths prompt_segment/cached_summary/embedding_pointer/retry_payload/fallback_transport with lineage_gap=True marking the transitive_gap family (POPETS-CASE-03/07 missing ancestry); subject_history_length in [3,6] per the blueprint's 3-6 longitudinal contexts per synthetic subject), derived by pure integer arithmetic from (seed, family, idx) - no RNG object, no clock, no dict iteration order, no live provider.
